_note: The compiler reads an {#each} pattern's annotation from `_ as <type>` after rewriting `?:` to `:`, but keeps using the rewritten text's positions. Each removed `?` moves the end one character earlier, so the reading resumes on the type literal's own `}`, which closes the tag: `, i}` becomes text and `i` is never declared. We found the tag's end by counting braces first, closed it at the real `}` and declared `i` as the index.
